subject: Legora raises $550M Series E at $8.8B valuation, with J.P. Morgan and Fidelity among new investors
text:
Source (primary): https://legora.com/blog/series-e (21 Oct; source.mjs reads it)
Why it fits: beat 5, an AI deal with bank investors (J.P. Morgan and Fidelity among the new investors in the $550M Series E at an $8.8B valuation). (Filed by Site Watch, relayed by Marc.)
